'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[10 October 2022 missile strikes on Ukraine]]
****The [[Russian Armed Forces]] launch [[missile]] strikes on the [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] cities and towns of [[Kyiv]], [[Kharkiv]], [[Khmelnytskyi]], [[Zhytomyr]], [[Zaporizhzhia]], [[Ivano-Frankivsk]], [[Sumy]], [[Dnipro]], [[Lviv]], [[Ternopil]] and [[Poltava]], killing at least nineteen people and injuring hundreds more. ***[[Moldova–Russia relations]]
****[[Moldova]] confirms that [[Russian Navy]] warships in the [[Black Sea]] fired [[cruise missile]]s through its [[airspace]] to strike targets inside Ukraine. The Russian ambassador is subsequently summoned by Moldovan authorities to explain the violation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldova-says-three-russian-cruise-missiles-crossed-moldovan-air-space-2022-10-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Americans]] [[Ben Bernanke]], [[Douglas Diamond]] and [[Philip H. Dybvig]] are awarded the [[Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences]] "for research on banks and financial crises". [https://www.cbc.ca/news/business/nobel-economics-ben-bernanke-douglas-diamond-philip-dybvig-1.6611923 (CBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–Poland relations]]
**[[Poland]] advises its citizens to leave [[Belarus]] by "commercial or private means" amid deteriorating relations between the two countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/poland-advises-its-citizens-leave-belarus-2022-10-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Former [[Liberia]]n rebel commander [[Kunti Kamara]] goes on trial in [[Paris|Paris, France]] for [[war crimes]] and [[crimes against humanity]], in a precedent-setting French trial under the doctrine of [[universal jurisdiction]]. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Malaysian general election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Malaysia]] [[Ismail Sabri]] dissolves [[parliament of Malaysia|parliament]], with [[snap election]]s to be held later this year. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/pm-ismail-dissolves-malaysian-parliament-paving-way-for-snap-elections (''The Straits Times'')]
*[[2022 Lesotho general election]]
**The [[Revolution for Prosperity]] party wins the election by a small margin, but falls short of controlling the [[National Assembly (Lesotho)|National Assembly]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/lesothos-rfp-wins-most-parliamentary-seats-election-falls-short-majority-2022-10-10/ (Reuters)] 

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Chicago Marathon]]
**Kenyans [[Benson Kipruto]] and [[Ruth Chepngetich]] win the [[Chicago Marathon]], with Chepngetich defending her title. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/oct/09/ruth-chepngetich-misses-world-record-by-14-seconds-in-chicago-marathon-victory (''The Guardian'')]
